stories.title: North Wales police commissioner backs devolution but warns against Cardiff pull
stories.summary: The Police and Crime Commissioner for North Wales has said any transfer of policing powers from Westminster to Cardiff must not leave the north short of money or a say in how its force is run. stories.title: Chester Zoo cuts afternoon entry to £10 until 6 September
stories.summary: Chester Zoo is selling afternoon entry for £10 until 6 September, with tickets valid from 3pm and last admission at 5pm. The zoo closes at 6pm. stories.title: Developer seeks costs from Flintshire council over refused Ewloe housing scheme
stories.summary: A developer is asking for Flintshire County Council to pay its costs after councillors refused 315 homes in Ewloe against the advice of their own planning officers. stories.title: Food Standards Agency repeats egg advice as salmonella outbreak linked to imported eggs grows
stories.summary: Pregnant women, young children and older people in Flintshire are being advised to avoid dishes made with raw or lightly cooked egg when eating out. The advice comes from the Food Standards Agency, which is investigating a salmonella outbreak alongside the UK Health Security Agency.
